the_ruling_verbatim: each device should own it's own everything as much as possible, that's encapsulation. SO RULED.
since each device's shim is responsible for it's messaging, that device can sort routing based on predicate. or anything else for that matter. that should be the pattern everywhere.

the shim is already responsible for interfacing the bus (a single interface everyone can talk and listen on) to the device that owns it. so since the shim knows about the device, it should know exactly how each everythign should be routed. not even just messages :)
now_the_spec_says: A device owns its own everything as far as possible. Its SHIM is its sole router — messages and everything else, predicates included. A device never registers a predicate inside a foreign device: it declares it, its own shim fires it. advertise/subscribe dies.
